spans.text: Etere hm, nge si ti emen, ane dzam tob bod be fe asu na betobo mis, añu ai meló moe.

folded.id: asu mie|bod|ya minnam
folded.subject: asu mie
folded.object: ya minnam

spans.text: Eyóñ bia noñ na fulu mbga etam, fulu anyañ, fulu ediñ ndzo ene mfi asu mie bod ya minnam.

folded.id: ayian fe|ai|evoli abog okoan
folded.subject: ayian fe
folded.object: evoli abog okoan

spans.text: Enyiñ, mod ose abele ngul y'adzeñ na atobo mvoe, atoñ emien a nda bod dzie; ayian fe ai evoli abog okoan, akus, ayom nge ki abog ane ntet.

folded.id: ayian ki|ai|tun nged
folded.subject: ayian ki
folded.object: tun nged

spans.text: Mod ayian ki ai tun nged.

folded.id: b'osu y'a|nnam|etii ai nyian e boan be nnam bese bewóg
folded.subject: b'osu y'a
folded.object: etii ai nyian e boan be nnam bese bewóg

spans.text: Edzoe betebe b'osu y'a nnam etii ai nyian e boan be nnam bese bewóg.

folded.id: bene|ya|bebele na beboban akyae nnam watele
folded.subject: bene
folded.object: bebele na beboban akyae nnam watele

spans.text: Edzoe y'atoban a sosoo, a zen be obene-bene ya bebele na beboban akyae nnam watele.

folded.id: da mvemde|nnam|yayian kaman ai bebo bisye asui na bod be bi esie kom ese
folded.subject: da Mvemde
folded.object: yayian Kaman ai bebo bisye asui na bod be bi esie kom ese

spans.text: Ve da Mvemde nnam yayian Kaman ai bebo bisye asui na bod be bi esie kom ese.

folded.id: dañ mam|ya|metii ai atii die
folded.subject: dañ mam
folded.object: metii ai atii die

spans.text: Mod abele ki na abebe enyiñ e mod mbog adañ dañ mam ya metii ai atii die.

folded.id: dzam tob|bod|be fe asu na betobo mis
folded.subject: dzam tob
folded.object: be fe asu na betobo mis

spans.text: Etere hm, nge si ti emen, ane dzam tob bod be fe asu na betobo mis, añu ai meló moe.

folded.id: dzeñ mvoe|nnam|mfe
folded.subject: dzeñ mvoe
folded.object: mfe

spans.text: Nnam eñeñam ene, mod ose ane ngul y'akodo ake dzeñ mvoe nnam mfe.

folded.id: dzos|ya|nda medzo etam ave boban a mis mebod tege dañ mvende ndo alede na mod abó evus
folded.subject: Dzos
folded.object: nda medzo etam ave boban a mis mebod tege dañ mvende ndo alede na mod abó evus

spans.text: Dzos ya nda medzo etam ave boban a mis mebod tege dañ mvende ndo alede na mod abó evus.

folded.id: e minsingi|ai|minyanda a minnam
folded.subject: e minsingi
folded.object: minyanda a minnam

spans.text: Eyóñ bia noñ na fili ya nyol ai a nsisim ene dzom ya mod ose ayi, adzeñe fe, ai na ndimi, tege yene, ebiandi y'akar so e minsingi ai minyanda a minnam.

folded.id: e na|bod|be za bam nge batibili bo
folded.subject: e na
folded.object: be za bam nge batibili bo

spans.text: Eyóñ bia noñ na ngomena ayian kala enyiñ asu e na bod be za bam nge batibili bo.

folded.id: e za|nnam|asu na adugan a nnam abiale woe
folded.subject: e za
folded.object: asu na adugan a nnam abiale woe

spans.text: Nge ki akodo e za nnam asu na adugan a nnam abiale woe.

folded.id: ebi|ai|etibili bene eki
folded.subject: Ebi
folded.object: etibili bene eki

spans.text: Ebi ai etibili bene eki.

folded.id: ebod bewog|ai|asu nnan asui na enyiñ etoba oveves
folded.subject: ebod bewog
folded.object: asu nnan asui na enyiñ etoba oveves

spans.text: Ve da Mvende y'akar bia biki bine asu oluga ebod bewog ai asu nnan asui na enyiñ etoba oveves.

folded.id: ekpee mekeñ|ya|nnam
folded.subject: ekpee mekeñ
folded.object: nnam

spans.text: Mod ose ane ngul y'anonñ ngab ekpee mekeñ ya nnam, a dzeñ me zen ya make ai nnam osu, amu mebugban yete mene fe e woe.

folded.id: enyiń atele|nnam|ose etu dzia
folded.subject: Enyiń atele
folded.object: ose etu dzia

spans.text: Mfa mbóg Akōk Memevende Enyiń atele nnam ose etu dzia.

folded.id: etsig ntol|ya|nnam woe nge adañ fe kwi nala n'abe e endegele mezen ya akōk memvende ya nnam voe l'akaman ai nye
folded.subject: etsig ntol
folded.object: nnam woe nge adañ fe kwi nala n'abe e endegele mezen ya Akōk Memvende ya nnam voe l'akaman ai nye

spans.text: Mod ose abele ngul n'ake etsig ntol ya nnam woe nge adañ fe kwi nala n'abe e endegele mezen ya Akōk Memvende ya nnam voe l'akaman ai nye.

folded.id: fili ntsogan|ai|fili nkobo
folded.subject: fili ntsogan
folded.object: fili nkobo

spans.text: Mod ose abele fili ntsogan ai fili nkobo.

folded.id: matinban ve|ai|nyian fam ai minnga ya badzo na balug
folded.subject: matinban ve
folded.object: nyian fam ai minnga ya badzo na balug

spans.text: Metiñ m'alug matinban ve ai nyian fam ai minnga ya badzo na balug.

folded.id: mbog antoa|ai|mfi na enyiñ ewulu mezen mene sosoo
folded.subject: mbog antoa
folded.object: mfi na enyiñ ewulu mezen mene sosoo

spans.text: Ve abiali te, mod ose ayem dze ene abe, dze ene mbeñ asu e mod mbog antoa ai mfi na enyiñ ewulu mezen mene sosoo.

folded.id: me zen|ya|make ai nnam osu
folded.subject: me zen
folded.object: make ai nnam osu

spans.text: Mod ose ane ngul y'anonñ ngab ekpee mekeñ ya nnam, a dzeñ me zen ya make ai nnam osu, amu mebugban yete mene fe e woe.

folded.id: memvende me|nnam|mayian kala benyia be boan ai boan beben
folded.subject: Memvende me
folded.object: mayian kala benyia be boan ai boan beben

spans.text: Memvende me nnam mayian kala benyia be boan ai boan beben.

folded.id: metiñ m'alug|ai|abonde nda bod tege ai sesala - akyae ane osusua ai amos alug
folded.subject: metiñ m'alug
folded.object: abonde nda bod tege ai sesala - Akyae ane osusua ai amos alug

spans.text: A si fam ai mninga abog bekui ya bod, bebele ngul y'atindi metiñ m'alug ai abonde nda bod tege ai sesala - Akyae ane osusua ai amos alug, fam ai minnga bene etie dzia dzia a mis me mvende abog beman y'alug.

folded.id: minnam mbamena|ai|ekuan elad meyoñ mo yebe ovañ ye na si ese ebaala memvende m'enyiñ ma
folded.subject: minnam mbamena
folded.object: Ekuan Elad meyoñ mo yebe ovañ ye na si ese ebaala memvende m'enyiñ ma

spans.text: Eyóñ bia noñ na abui minnam mbamena ai Ekuan Elad meyoñ mo yebe ovañ ye na si ese ebaala memvende m'enyiñ ma.

folded.id: moan|nnam|ose abele ngul y'anóñ ngab e mam ya mabebe nnam woe
folded.subject: Moan
folded.object: ose abele ngul y'anóñ ngab e mam ya mabebe nnam woe

spans.text: Moan nnam ose abele ngul y'anóñ ngab e mam ya mabebe nnam woe.

folded.id: mvende|ya|bi mod ose akyae da
folded.subject: Mvende
folded.object: bi mod ose akyae da

spans.text: Mvende ya bi mod ose akyae da.

folded.id: na akaman|ai|e dzom se abonde akeñ die ayób
folded.subject: na akaman
folded.object: e dzom se abonde akeñ die ayób

spans.text: Mod ose abele na akaman ai e dzom se abonde akeñ die ayób.

folded.id: na enyiñ|bod|bese etebe etu dzia
folded.subject: na enyiñ
folded.object: bese etebe etu dzia

spans.text: Eyóñ bia noñ na Akōk Memvende Ekuan Elad Meyoñ amem na aluman asu na enyiñ bod bese etebe etu dzia.

folded.id: na fili|ya|nyol ai a nsisim ene dzom ya mod ose ayi
folded.subject: na fili
folded.object: nyol ai a nsisim ene dzom ya mod ose ayi

spans.text: Eyóñ bia noñ na fili ya nyol ai a nsisim ene dzom ya mod ose ayi, adzeñe fe, ai na ndimi, tege yene, ebiandi y'akar so e minsingi ai minyanda a minnam.

folded.id: nda|bod|ene tin enyiñ asu te memvende me nnane mebele na mekalaga dzó
folded.subject: Nda
folded.object: ene tin enyiñ asu te memvende me nnane mebele na mekalaga dzó

spans.text: Nda bod ene tin enyiñ asu te memvende me nnane mebele na mekalaga dzó.

folded.id: ndzoñ te|nnam|ose obele nkil woe
folded.subject: ndzoñ te
folded.object: ose obele nkil woe

spans.text: Antoa na a zen te, a ndzoñ te nnam ose obele nkil woe, ve da, ntsogan one mbog: olugu etie mod.

folded.id: ngomena a|nnam|woe
folded.subject: ngomena a
folded.object: woe

spans.text: Mod ose abele ngul na sie ngomena a nnam woe.

folded.id: ngul y'atsog|ai|ayebe aktae die a nnem etere nge ki a nkunda
folded.subject: ngul y'atsog
folded.object: ayebe aktae die a nnem etere nge ki a nkunda

spans.text: Mod ose ane ngul y'atsog ai ayebe aktae die a nnem etere nge ki a nkunda.
Mod ose abele ngul y'alad ai nkunda mise ma sie asu elad minnem, mi saala eñeñam azañ menda me bod.

folded.id: office|of|the united nations high commissioner for human rights (ohchr)
folded.subject: Office
folded.object: the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR)

spans.text: Universal Declaration of Human Rights Language: Bulu (bum) Adopted: UN General Assembly resolution 217 A (III), Paris, 10 December 1948 Publisher: Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR)

folded.id: ose abele|nnam|abiali abe si dzam suñ ai nye
folded.subject: ose abele
folded.object: abiali abe si dzam suñ ai nye

spans.text: Mod ose abele nnam abiali abe si dzam suñ ai nye.

folded.id: ose akiebe|ai|etoa fili
folded.subject: ose akiebe
folded.object: etoa fili

spans.text: Mod ose akiebe ai etoa fili.

folded.id: ose ayian|ai|enyiñ ai e dzom y'akala enyiñ dzie
folded.subject: ose ayian
folded.object: enyiñ ai e dzom y'akala enyiñ dzie

spans.text: Mod ose ayian ai enyiñ ai e dzom y'akala enyiñ dzie.
Mod ziñ ayian ki ai endegele ntie mvende ya nnam y'ayem ki evus dzie.

folded.id: si fam|ai|mninga abog bekui ya bod
folded.subject: si fam
folded.object: mninga abog bekui ya bod

spans.text: A si fam ai mninga abog bekui ya bod, bebele ngul y'atindi metiñ m'alug ai abonde nda bod tege ai sesala - Akyae ane osusua ai amos alug, fam ai minnga bene etie dzia dzia a mis me mvende abog beman y'alug.

folded.id: sosoo|ai|mvoe bia so bia olugu biave ekokom mod
folded.subject: sosoo
folded.object: mvoe bia so bia olugu biave ekokom mod

spans.text: Eyóñ bia noñ na fili, sosoo ai mvoe bia so bia olugu biave ekokom mod.

folded.id: tege|ai|sesala
folded.subject: tege
folded.object: sesala

spans.text: Abiali bod bese, tege ai sesala, bene etie dzia a mis memvende y'enyiñ, dzom dzia etu fili nkóbó, fili ntsogan, fili mboan.
Fam, mininga, mbubua, ebig, Evindi, Ntañan mod ose tege ai sesala.

folded.id: to|nnam|ziñ obele ki na obó mam me fe m'atoban ki ai akōk memvende di
folded.subject: to
folded.object: ziñ obele ki na obó mam me fe m'atoban ki ai Akōk Memvende di

spans.text: To mod mbog, to nkunda, to nnam ziñ obele ki na obó mam me fe m'atoban ki ai Akōk Memvende di.

folded.id: y'abole a|nnam|abiali woe ake tobo mfa se y'adiñ
folded.subject: y'abole a
folded.object: abiali woe ake tobo mfa se y'adiñ

spans.text: Mod ose abele ngul y'abole a nnam abiali woe ake tobo mfa se y'adiñ.

folded.id: y'akala fe|bod|bese akyae deda
folded.subject: Y'akala fe
folded.object: bese akyae deda

spans.text: Mvende Y'akala fe bod bese akyae deda.
